text.title: Inference Cost Unit Economics Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the unit-economics report: a pinned price sheet, provider-usage token source, and per feature the success definition, four cost lines, p50/p95/mean cost per outcome over a window of at least seven days, retry share, revenue basis, gross margin, ceiling and spend alert. Validator: `scripts/validate-inference-cost-unit-economics.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the schema cannot express and the reviewer checks by hand: `over_ceiling` lists exactly the features whose `cost_per_outcome.mean` exceeds `cost_ceiling_per_outcome` (r-cost-ceiling-and-runaway-alert); `tail_dominated` is true exactly when `p95 > 5 x p50` (r-report-tail-not-only-mean); `gross_margin_pct` equals `(revenue_per_outcome - cost_per_outcome.mean) / revenue_per_outcome` (r-gross-margin-with-stated-revenue-basis); every `cost_lines` figure traces to the `usage` object logged per call, not to a character count (r-token-counts-from-provider-usage).

example.note: Seven subject violations: a 3-day window (r-report-tail-not-only-mean needs 7), tokens estimated from characters (r-token-counts-from-provider-usage), cost per call as headline (r-cost-per-successful-outcome), a blended `llm` line instead of input and output tokens (r-four-component-decomposition), only the mean with no p50/p95, retry share 40% with no cause named and `first_action` pointing at the prompt (r-retry-share-reported), an allocation rule without its key (r-gross-margin-with-stated-revenue-basis), and a tail-dominated feature with no driver.

antipattern.description: `headline_metric` is anything other than `cost_per_successful_outcome`, or `cost_per_call` appears without `cost_per_outcome` beside it.
antipattern.reason: r-cost-per-successful-outcome: the invoice is paid per outcome, not per call.

antipattern.description: `retry_share_pct` above 15 while `first_action` names the prompt or the model, or `retry_cause` is absent.
antipattern.reason: r-retry-share-reported: prompt changes cannot move a cost that is a retry loop.

antipattern.description: `token_source` is anything but `provider_usage`; a cost line derived from character or word counts.
antipattern.reason: r-token-counts-from-provider-usage: estimates miss system prompts, tool schemas and retrieval context.

antipattern.description: A `price_sheet` entry without `sheet_date`, without a snapshot-level `model_id`, or with a blended rate and no `discount_kind`.
antipattern.reason: r-price-sheet-pinned: an undated price cannot be diffed against the next report.

antipattern.description: `cost_per_outcome` carries only `mean`; `window.days` below 7; `p95 > 5 x p50` with `tail_dominated` false or `tail_driver` missing.
antipattern.reason: r-report-tail-not-only-mean: the tail is where the margin is lost.
r-gross-margin-with-stated-revenue-basis: two reports with different keys give 40% and 85% for the same feature.

antipattern.description: A feature without `cost_ceiling_per_outcome` or `daily_spend_alert.wired_to`; a feature over its ceiling missing from `over_ceiling`, or listed without `action_owner`.
antipattern.reason: r-cost-ceiling-and-runaway-alert: a runaway with no alert is found on the invoice.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
